events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Decision needed: migration paused after batch 3 because validation found incorrect phone numbers. Of 120 migrated records, 31 overseas customers were incorrectly assigned +1 country codes. Batches 4–10 (280 records) would have the same problem. The new CRM reports 14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; whether they used affected numbers is unknown. Recommend immediately warning sales users not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers, verifying correct country codes from authoritative sources, and correcting the import mapping before repairing the 31 records and resuming. No further batches or phone edits have been run. Please authorize the repair approach and targeted sales warning; validation did not supply affected customer IDs or correct country codes.
